identity.input_hash_definition: exporter._hashes / exporter._canonical_hash: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON (sorted object keys; array order preserved), computed by the pinned revision's own code.
identity.producer_materialization_layer: git blob bytes (LF) at the pinned revision via git cat-file, byte-verified with git hash-object against git ls-tree OIDs; disk and git-archive forms are checkout materializations (B4 law).
identity.report_identity_layer: exporter canonical JSON: sha256 over json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + newline (ASCII). NOT disk bytes, NOT git blob bytes.

independent_checks_note: Independent analytic checks are retained: the legacy suites, proof batteries, and admission/compiler refusals remain the correctness layer for the physical inputs and the producer; this verifier adds source-bound producer agreement only.
